verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Adyen Issuing lets founders create Mastercard/Visa cards, manage balances, and onboard quickly using existing KYC data, implying Adyen handles BIN sponsorship/network membership so the customer doesn't need to become a bank (adyen-issuing-docs-1, adyen-issuing-docs-26, adyen-issuing-docs-14). However, there is no explicit documentation of BIN sponsorship terms, network membership structure, or a stated timeline from signup to first live card. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/network membership details, a documented signup-to-live-card timeline, and any case study or benchmark showing speed to launch.
